title: Frozen card: why, unfreeze it, and a refund on the frozen account

turns.reply: I'm sorry, that's stressful when you need your medicine. To look at your card, I first need to check it's you. Please send the email on your Paylane account and the last 4 digits of your card, but not the full card number.
